body.name: \(A^L_r\)
body.def: For each cell, let \(D\) be the diagonal zero-one mask recorded by \(r\). The zero branch contributes \(0\); a cut \(t\) with gap branch \(\gamma\in\{0,1\}\) contributes \(D[(\mathbf 1\{k\le t\}-\gamma\mathbf 1_K)_{k=0}^{K-1},(-\mathbf 1\{k\le t\}+\gamma\mathbf 1_K)_{k=0}^{K-1}]^{\prime}\). Stack these cell vectors over \(x\).
